landing.subtitle: Join our fun-first volleyball sessions designed for beginners. No pressure, no stress, just good vibes and good games.
landing.openSessionsSubtitle: Grab your spot, they go fast!
landing.noOpenSessions: No open sessions right now. Check back soon!
landing.step1Desc: Choose a fun session that fits your schedule. All levels welcome!
landing.step2Desc: Confirm your spot and pay. Simple, fast, secure.
landing.step3Desc: Bring your energy! Arrive 10 min early and enjoy the game.
landing.rule1: Arrive 10 minutes before the session starts.
landing.rule2: Bring sports shoes, water bottle, and a towel.
landing.rule3: Respect all players. We're here for fun!
landing.rule4: No-shows may affect future booking priority.
landing.rule6: Cancel at least 24h ahead to free your slot.
landing.getInTouchSubtitle: Questions? Message us or join the group chat!
landing.clickToJoinGroup: Click to join the group chat
landing.faqA1: Not at all! {{clubName}} is designed for beginners. Just bring your energy and willingness to learn.
landing.faqA2: You can cancel up to 24 hours before the session to free up your slot. However, all bookings are non-refundable.
landing.faqQ3: What if a session is full?
landing.faqA3: Join the waiting list. When a place opens up, you're booked in automatically in queue order and we'll let you know. Then pay and upload your receipt within the hold time (up to 12 hours).
landing.faqQ4: How do I contact the club?
landing.faqA4: Message us on WhatsApp at {{whatsapp}} or join our WhatsApp group.

landing.heroSubtitle: Book social volleyball sessions, meet real players, and join the VSB community.
landing.heroAlt: VSB players in the home kit, standing together on an indoor volleyball court
landing.step1Desc: Browse games by date, level and venue, and see who's already in.

landing.communityBody: First-timers and regulars, setters and liberos, every level on the same court. VSB is where Malaysia’s social volleyball players find each other.

whatsNew.rule1Body: Unpaid places are released after 12 hours (or 2 hours before the game, whichever is sooner). Upload your receipt to stop the clock.
whatsNew.rule2Body: Game full? Join the waiting list. When a place opens, the next person is booked in automatically. You can see the queue under Who's Playing.
whatsNew.rule3Body: Bring one friend: a guest, or a VSB member picked from the list.
whatsNew.feature1Body: One photo becomes your own VSB player, in the pose you choose. It appears on your card, the court and the community.
whatsNew.feature2Body: Tell other players how you like to play: playstyle, game vibe and why you play.
whatsNew.feature3Body: Update your position, level and details any time in My VSB.
